readerCopy.body: The first boundary can carry the force of every boundary that was never allowed to stand. When Mars squares Lilith, action and refusal create friction, and a small demand can land with the weight of every earlier no that was softened, ignored, or negotiated away. A broader frustration can surface when people who have been expected to stay agreeable stop doing it. The anger may describe the pattern accurately while asking one moment to repair too much history at once. The boundary is easier to hold when it deals with the current demand without needing to settle every old score.
